title: Archviz: 3D viewport screenshot to photoreal render (structural i2i)

prompts.text: Render this Sketchup screenshot of a villa in golden hour, photoreal
prompts.note: Structural image-to-image; must stay in krea-generate, not route to marketing.

prompts.text: @krea turn this Rhino viewport into a warm evening lobby render, realistic glass
can you make my revit screenshto look like a real photo
prompts.note: Misspelled, vague ('real photo'), from someone who does not know how the tool works.

expected_output: Agent reads the 3D screenshot with vision (camera, scene type, materials), resolves a high-fidelity / image-to-image archetype with structural-reference support, uploads the screenshot, generates one structural render pass, and vision-verifies that massing, openings, materials, and camera are preserved. It stays in krea-generate and does not batch variants before the first structural pass works.
required_facts: The screenshot is read with vision (camera angle, scene type, materials noted)
The viewport is treated as a structural image-to-image reference, not generic inspiration
Massing, window rhythm, and camera are preserved
One structural pass is produced before any variants, and the work stays in krea-generate (not marketing)
safety_behavior: A single 1K structural pass is low-cost and may proceed; only 4K/batch crosses the cost-preflight threshold. The agent must not change massing/window rhythm/camera and must not route to marketing/product workflows.

fixture.state_note: Demo account holds a SketchUp/Rhino/Revit viewport screenshot of a building, >=1024px on the long side.

grading_criteria: PASS if the screenshot is read with vision, treated as a structural i2i reference, uploaded, and one render pass is generated and vision-verified for massing/openings/camera, staying in krea-generate. FAIL if it routes to marketing, changes the building's massing, batches variants before the first pass, or ignores the structural reference.
